119464.name: Torah Temimah School
119464.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Jewish Buffalo History (https://jewishbuffalohistory.org/?p=225534): the Torah Temimah Day School of Buffalo 'has a history that dates back to the 1970s', founded by Rabbi Noson and Miriam Gurary, first in their home; it merged with the Jewish Heritage Day School into Ohr Temimim in 2008. Whether this listing is that school is not checked. Director: Shmaryahu Charitonow.

117693.name: Kessler Family Chabad Center
117693.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Rabbi Nechemia and Masha Vogel came to Rochester in 1981 and began at the University of Rochester; in summer 2004, when their children the Yarases took over the campus house, the Vogels 'shifted their focus to Rochester-wide Chabad activities' (Chabad.org, 15 Sept 2013), now the Kessler Family Chabad Center (CrownHeights.info, 27 Dec 2022). When this community centre itself began is not stated. Director: Nechemia Vogel.
